versions.changelog_entry: Initial release. Astro Starlight setup as the unified documentation site for mediaite-ghostink, embedding the Quarto-rendered bound forensic report under /report/ and retiring the prior Cloudflare Pages deploy. Locked design decisions captured up front: website/ subdirectory in this repo (not a separate repo); GitHub Pages deploy (not Cloudflare); docs/ remains canonical with build-time copy and frontmatter injection (not a move); Quarto embedded under /report/ (not linked out); existing .github/workflows/deploy.yml deleted; CLI auto-generation via Typer-app introspection in scope for v0.1.0; Pagefind built-in search; v0.1.0 doc scope is core operator docs (ARCHITECTURE, RUNBOOK, TESTING, GUARDRAILS, DEPLOYMENTS, EXIT_CODES) plus all ADRs. Nine steps: create website/ via the official Starlight template, author astro.config.mjs (site + base for GH Pages, manual sidebar, Mermaid via rehype-mermaid, Forensic report sidebar entry pointing at /report/), build website/scripts/sync-docs.mjs (allow-list copy from docs/ to website/src/content/docs/synced/ with derived frontmatter and link rewriting), build scripts/generate_cli_docs.py (Typer introspection emitting docs/cli/*.md), hand-author index.mdx and getting-started.mdx, anchor the work to the Starlight components reference (https://starlight.astro.build/components/using-components/) and configuration reference (https://starlight.astro.build/reference/configuration/) with a required-components checklist (Steps/Aside/FileTree/Tabs on getting-started; CardGrid/LinkCard/Aside on the landing page) and an explicit list of in-scope vs. out-of-scope configuration knobs, add Makefile targets, replace .github/workflows/deploy.yml with .github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml that renders Quarto into website/public/report then builds and deploys Astro to GitHub Pages on push to main (with PR build-only validation), update RUNBOOK/GUARDRAILS/README/HANDOFF. 13 acceptance criteria including Quarto-source invariants, CI-workflow invariants for the six untouched workflows, deletion check on deploy.yml, idempotence checks on the sync script and CLI generator, and a component-usage check that greps the hand-authored MDX pages for the required Starlight components and confirms imports come from @astrojs/starlight/components. Verification commands prove sources are byte-identical, builds succeed, the embedded report appears in dist/report/, every sidebar entry resolves, and the required components are present on the hand-authored pages. Out-of-scope list prohibits Quarto edits, importing the full docs/ tree (only an allow-list), importing prompts/ or evals/, migrating README into Starlight, modifying any other CI workflow, performing repo settings changes, and adding versioning/i18n/analytics or alternative search backends. Rollback restores deploy.yml as the safety net.
